title: Kissed Buttery French Cherry Gratin
description: A rich and indulgent French dessert featuring caramelized cherries in a buttery sauce, perfect for special occasions. This dish is carefully crafted to avoid onions and garlic.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat and add the cherries, cooking until they release their juice and start to caramelize.
In a small bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, and salt, then add the mixture to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Gradually stir in the heavy cream and bring the mixture to a simmer, cooking until it thickens.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the egg yolks and vanilla extract, then temper the mixture by slowly pouring the warm cream mixture into the egg yolks.
Pour the mixture into a 6-inch baking dish and smooth the top.
Place the dish under the broiler and cook until the top is golden brown and caramelized.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it cool slightly before serving.
Serve the gratin warm, garnished with additional cherries if desired.
